# teams_resource_account (Resource)

Manages a Teams resource account, the identity that gives an auto attendant or call queue its phone number. Renames and deletes go through Microsoft Graph. Needs the Teams Telephony Administrator and User Administrator roles. To receive a phone number the account needs a Teams Phone Resource Account license, which is managed outside this provider (e.g. with azuread or in Microsoft 365).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "teams_resource_account" "support" {
  user_principal_name = "ra-support@contoso.com"
  display_name        = "Support line"
  type                = "call_queue"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Display name of the resource account.
- `type` (String) Resource account type: auto_attendant or call_queue. Changing it requires replacement.
- `user_principal_name` (String) User principal name of the resource account. Changing it requires replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object id of the resource account.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number assigned to the resource account, without the tel: prefix. Null when none is assigned or Teams does not report it.
